records.title: Maple Disruption 2.0
records.summary: Partners actioned 4,264 reports during the November operation. The release groups website removals and blocks with actions affecting phones, email and payments.

records.title: Fake help-desk calls at legal and financial firms
records.summary: Callers posing as internal support directed staff to branded sign-in pages. The Cyber Centre observed frequent changes of lure domains and identified infrastructure naming Canadian organizations.

records.title: Retailer lookalikes and fake checkouts
records.summary: The shopping guide describes imitation stores and payment pages reached through ads, messages and QR codes. It gives shoppers checks for independently verifying a retailer.

records.title: CRA describes its phishing-site removals
records.summary: The agency describes hundreds of phishing websites taken down annually. It gives the scale of the work without an exact year-by-year count.

records.title: Websites posing as government grant providers
records.summary: FCAC reports websites borrowing its identity to offer funding or grants. It explains how to recognize requests for personal information or upfront payments.

records.title: Impersonation in online ticket sales
records.summary: The Bureau describes fake sites, advertisements and social posts used to sell invalid tickets. It directs buyers to the venue for independent checks on an offer.

records.title: Government impersonation through fake sites and messages
records.summary: The Bureau describes false government websites and messages about programs or refunds. It also explains how fabricated audio and video can reinforce a false endorsement.

records.title: Phishing messages preserved by the Anti-Fraud Centre
records.summary: The Centre reproduces examples of parking-payment demands, benefit notices and licence-refund messages. The examples preserve the wording people encountered.

records.title: How phishing arrives by message, call or QR code
records.summary: An overview of targeted email, text and voice impersonation explains which information is at risk and how organizations can prepare employees to recognize attempts.

records.title: Cloud sign-in phishing in federal and partner organizations
records.summary: The Cyber Centre studied over 100 campaigns targeting Microsoft Entra ID accounts. Figure 7 breaks down cumulative results by two kinds of blocking and full session compromise.

records.title: Fraud reports involving QR codes and fake payment notices
records.summary: The Centre describes reports from marketplace sellers who received codes labelled as incoming payments. In some cases the code instead opened a request for money or banking details.
